name: Sodium Sulfacetamide 10% and Sulfur 5% Cleanser
indications_original: Sodium Sulfacetamide 10% & Sulfur 5% Cleanser is indicated in the topical control of acne vulgaris, acne rosacea and seborrheic dermatitis.
contraindications_original: Wash affected areas once or twice daily, or as directed by your physician. Avoid contact with eyes or mucous membranes. Wet skin and libera ly apply to areas to be cleansed, massage gently into skin for 10-20 seconds working into a full lather, rinse thoroughly and pat dry. If drying occurs, it may be contro led by rinsing cleanser off sooner or using less often.
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
Sodium Sulfacetamide 10% & Sulfur 5% Cleanser is available in 
    6 oz (170 g) bottle NDC 83720-547-06 
    12 oz (340 g) bottle NDC 83720-547-12
adverseReactions_original: Sodium Sulfacetamide 10% & Sulfur 5% Cleanser is contraindicated for use by patients having known hypersensitivity to sulfonamides, sulfur or any other component of this preparation. Sodium Sulfacetamide 10% & Sulfur 5% Cleanser is not to be used by patients with kidney disease.
